exercises.name: High Knee
exercises.instructions: Position: Drive your knees up toward your chest, pump your arms, and keep your core engaged.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.instructions: Position: Squat down, jump explosively upward, and land softly with your knees bent.

exercises.name: Burpee Pushups
exercises.instructions: Position: Drop into a plank, perform a push-up, bring your feet forward, then jump up.

exercises.name: Extended Crunches
exercises.instructions: Position: Extend your arms and legs, then crunch your upper body and knees toward each other.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.instructions: Position: Jump your feet apart as your arms go overhead, then return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Front Lunge
exercises.instructions: Position: Step forward, lower into a lunge, push back to standing, and alternate legs.

exercises.name: Superman Pullup
exercises.instructions: Position: Lift your chest and legs, pull your elbows toward your ribs, then extend your arms forward.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.instructions: Position: From a high plank, drive your knees toward your chest one at a time while keeping your core tight.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
exercises.instructions: Position: Jog in place while bringing your heels toward your glutes and keeping your upper body tall.

exercises.name: Plank Reaches
exercises.instructions: Position: Hold a high plank and reach one arm forward at a time while keeping your hips stable.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch Right
exercises.instructions: Position: Sit on mat, extend one leg forward with heel on floor, hinge forward at hips with flat back. Hold 30s per side. Breath: Deep, slow exhales to release hamstring tension.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch Left
exercises.instructions: Position: Sit on mat, extend one leg forward with heel on floor, hinge forward at hips with flat back. Hold 30s per side. Breath: Deep, slow exhales to release hamstring tension.

exercises.name: Quad stretch Right
exercises.instructions: Position: Sit on mat, extend one leg forward with heel on floor, hinge forward at hips with flat back. Hold 30s per side. Breath: Deep, slow exhales to release hamstring tension.

exercises.name: Quad stretch Left
exercises.instructions: Position: Sit on mat, extend one leg forward with heel on floor, hinge forward at hips with flat back. Hold 30s per side. Breath: Deep, slow exhales to release hamstring tension.

exercises.name: Front-Clasped
exercises.instructions: Position: Interlace your fingers in front of you, turn your palms outward, and press your arms straight out at shoulder height. Round your upper back and push forward while gently tucking your chin to deeply stretch the muscles between your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Behind-the-Back Clasp
exercises.instructions: Position: Clasp hands behind your back, straighten elbows, and gently lift/press shoulder blades together while lifting the chest.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch Right
exercises.instructions: Position: Clasp hands behind your back, straighten elbows, and gently lift/press shoulder blades together while lifting the chest.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch Left
exercises.instructions: Position: Reach one arm overhead, bend elbow to place hand on upper back, gently press elbow back with opposite hand. Hold 30s per side. Breath: Slow diaphragmatic breathing.
